class.name: IfcStructuralLoadSingleDisplacement
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Instances of the entity IfcStructuralLoadSingleDisplacement shall be used to define displacements. HISTORY: New entity in Release IFC2x edition 2.

members.member: Displacement in x-direction. A float, or null when unset.
